name: brokk-observe
description: Audit trail for Claude Code: ships every session's prompts, tool calls, commits and PRs to your Brokk Observe server for security review, leaderboards and bug attribution.

server_url.title: Brokk Observe server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your Brokk Observe server, e.g. https://observe.example.com. Leave empty if your organization sets OBSERVE_URL centrally.

ingest_token.title: Ingest token
ingest_token.description: A bko_ingest_... key from the dashboard's Settings page. Leave empty if your organization sets OBSERVE_TOKEN centrally.

enforce_policies.title: Enforce organization policies
enforce_policies.description: Ask the server for an allow/ask/deny decision before every tool call. Adds one network round-trip per tool call.

upload_transcripts.title: Upload transcripts
upload_transcripts.description: Upload the conversation transcript (secrets are redacted server-side) for LLM audit and token/cost tracking.

github_login.title: GitHub login
github_login.description: Optional. Links your sessions to your PRs and reviews. Detected automatically from the gh CLI when available.
